To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the performance of an evaporator heat exchangers for an air conditioner, using a ternary mixture as a replacement refrigerant for R 22, is around 7. 4% less than that using R 22 and the cooling capacity for both R 22 and ternary mixture improved with flooded evaporators by around 8.6 and 15%, respectively.
the ternary mixture of 30% R 32/10% R 125/60% R 134a can be used as a replacement for R 22 in a window air conditioner.
a heat exchanger evaporator with flooded coils using a zeotropic mixture of refrigerants has a lower performance than an evaporator using a single component refrigerant.

the use of heat exchange as the evaporator is feasible for the replacement of R 22 with the ternary mixture.

the performance of a heat exchanger evaporator using ternary mixture is acceptable for a window air conditioner.

the performance of ternaries in a flooded evaporator can be comparable to R 22.
heat exchangers, in general, and the evaporator, in particular, can be used as the heat transfer device in an air conditioner.
